notes: Track 0 Sec 8: the Schedule A attachment-selection contract is computed Schedule A total strictly greater than the standard deduction -> required, less-than-or-equal -> not-required (deterministic tie favors standard). The attachment machinery's requirement shape compares a subtotal symbol to a static threshold_parameter, never to another dynamic symbol; this rule expresses the dynamic standard-deduction comparison as a single signed difference so the attachment can reuse the existing subtotal-over-threshold-parameter(default-zero) shape verbatim (matching attachment.f8949.json / attachment.schedule-d.v3.json precedent), with no new attachment ontology. tax.us.2025.schedule-a.total always publishes (0 when no Form 1098 statement is on record, per rule.schedule-a-total-closed-empty.json's producer route), so this rule's own unconditional requires+ref is always eventually satisfiable via ordinary multi-pass saturation - no count-based guard duplication needed here.
